messages.text: People want to come in but your park is closed. You should think about opening up.
Lots of your visitors are thirsty. Maybe you should build some more drinks shops?
People are getting hungry and there aren't enough food shops. Do you think you should build some more?
Your rides are starting to wear out but you don't have any mechanics. You should think about hiring some.
The rides are breaking down but you have no mechanics. You should hire some!
There aren't enough mechanics to service all the rides. Maybe you should think about hiring some more.
You've no cleaners and the park is starting to get untidy. Maybe you should hire some?
You've no cleaners and the park is very untidy. You should hire some!
Your park is filthy because you don't have enough cleaners. You should hire some more.
The park is getting busy and you don't have any guards. Maybe you should hire some?
The park doesn't have any guards and some of the visitors are misbehaving. You should hire some soon!
You need more guards to deal with a park of this size. Have you considered hiring more?
You've no entertainers and the park is starting to get busy. Maybe you should hire some?
You've built most of the available rides and you don't have anyone to research new ones. Maybe you should hire some researchers?
You've no researchers and you've built all the available rides. You should hire some!
Your research is taking a long time. You might speed things up by hiring more researchers.
Your mechanics could be more efficient if you set their patrol areas.
There are parts of your park without a mechanic patrolling them.
Your cleaners could do a better job if you set their patrol areas.
Some areas of your park don't have a cleaner patrolling them.
If you built some security cameras it would help your guards do their job.
If you set their patrol areas, your guards would be more efficient.
Some parts of the park don't have a guard patrolling them or even a security camera.
Your entertainers are covering too wide an area. It would help if you set their patrol areas.
There are areas of your park that aren't being patrolled by an entertainer.
Your mechanics would do a better job if you trained them.
Training your cleaners would make them more efficient.
Your guards aren't very efficient. Perhaps you should train them?
Your entertainers are not as entertaining as they could be. Training them would help.
Your researchers could do their job better and faster if you trained them.
Visitors are getting bored waiting in your long queues. Try reducing the ride duration, or at least place an entertainer nearby.
Your selection of rides isn't so good. You should build some more.
You've built all of the currently available rides. If you research others you could make your park more varied.
Your park has no rides in it. Perhaps now's a good time to build some?
It's about time you researched some ride upgrades. As yet you don't have any.
You haven't researched many ride upgrades. Perhaps you should research some more?
There are ride upgrades available that you haven't yet used.
Your selection of shops isn't great. You should build some more.
You've built all your shops. You could get more by doing research.
You haven't built any shops yet, and your visitors are just itching to buy things.
A park of this size should have more shops in it. Maybe you should build some more.
Your park doesn't have a great selection of sideshows. You should build some more.
All the available sideshows have now been built. Perhaps it's time to research some more?
Your park has no sideshows yet. Now might be a good time to invest in some.
You haven't got many sideshows for a park of this size. Maybe you should build some more?
If you built some more features your park would look better, and your visitors might be happier.
All the available features have been built. Maybe you should research some more?
Your park isn't as pretty as it might be. It would look better if you put down some features.
Your park needs some toilets, so your visitors have somewhere to go.
Some visitors are having to walk miles to a toilet. Perhaps you should build some more?
A park this size should have more toilets.
Your toilets are getting dirty and you have no cleaners. If you don't want to lose visitors, you should hire some.
Your toilets are getting dirty. Make sure a cleaner is patrolling them.
People are complaining that your toilets are dirty. You should hire some cleaners!
Your toilets are so filthy they are making people sick. A cleaner should be patrolling them at all times.
Some visitors think your ticket price is too high. Can you consider lowering it?
Interestingly, some visitors believe your ticket price is cheap. Is there room for you to raise it?
Some of the visitors are misbehaving and your security hasn't seen it. Make sure your guards are patrolling all areas of the park, or build security cameras.
You could spend some of your accumulated wealth to improve your park.
Staff wages are higher than your income. You need to do something about this - perhaps you could get rid of the most expensive employees?
Is it really necessary to have so many cleaners in a park this size?
You have a lot of entertainers for a park this size. Are they all really necessary?
The number of mechanics you've employed is too high for a park this size.
With a park this size, you don't need so many security guards.
You could get away with fewer researchers in a park this size.
You have employed the maximum number of cleaners for a park, so in future instead of hiring more cleaners you'll have to train the ones you have.
Your entertainer list has reached maximum, so from now on if you need to improve your entertainer workforce then you'll have to train them.
You now have employed the maximum number of mechanics for a park, so any improvements to your mechanic workforce will involve training.
You've got as many guards as a park can handle. Improving your security workforce in the future will mean training them.
You've employed the maximum number of researchers. If you need to improve your research efficiency, you'll need to train them.
The buzz about your park has died down. However, placing down a new ride creates new hype, meaning more people are attracted to your park for a while.
The visitors to your park are really enjoying themselves. Keep up the good work!
Your guards are well trained. Any trouble caused in your park gets dealt with quickly and efficiently.
Your researchers are among the best in the world. Training them has really paid off.
Your cleaners are well trained and efficient. Training them was worth the money.
Your entertainers have been trained well and are making people very happy.
Your mechanics are highly skilled now thanks to your training initiative.
Lots of visitors are buying balloons. This is a good indication that they're really happy.
Many of your visitors are buying souvenirs from the gift shop before they leave. This tells you they enjoyed their day out and may come back!
Your staff are exhausted and are working poorly. I think you should build them a staff room, or risk a strike.
Don't you think it's about time you hired some staff?
Try setting patrol areas to make your staff work more efficiently.
Training your staff will improve the working ability.
Have you seen how many costumes people are buying? They're having a great time!
Your bank balance is looking pretty low! I think you need to curb your spending before you end up in the red.
Your bank balance isn't looking very healthy! I think you need to cut down on spending, and possibly take out a loan, before you end up in the red.
Visitors don't think your food is a very good deal. You need to improve the situation if you want them to buy something to eat.
Visitors think your shops aren't much of a bargain. They need to get more value for their money if you want them to buy anything.
Visitors aren't finding much value at your restaurants. You should improve the situation if you want them to eat there.
People think your drinks are, well, poor value. You need to make improvements if you want them to buy drinks.
Visitors are not impressed with the value at some of your sideshows. You ought to improve this if you want people to play.
Some of the people who've eaten in your park feel like they've had a bad deal. You need to improve the situation before more visitors get angry.
Some of the customers at your shops aren't happy with the quality of the merchandise. You need to make improvements before more people get mad.
Some customers are unhappy with the quality at your restaurants. You need to make improvements or more people will get angry.
Some visitors who've bought drinks went away dissatisfied with the quality. You ought to make improvements before more people get angry.
Some of the visitors who tried your sideshows aren't happy. You should try to find out what went wrong.
People think your food is great value. Nice one!
Visitors are impressed with the value at your shops. Well done!
Visitors think your restaurants are a great deal. Nicely done!
People are impressed with your drinks. They think they're a great deal! Congratulations.
People think your sideshows are a really good deal! Keep up the good work!
The visitors who've eaten in your park are very satisfied. The ones who haven't are...skinny. Congratulations for the first one, at least.
Customers at your shops feel like they've had a good deal. You're a marketing genius! Congratulations!
Visitors who've eaten at your restaurants are very satisfied. The visitors who haven't are hungry. You should be very proud, regardless.
Visitors are very happy with the drinks they've bought in your park. Keep up the good work!
Good news! People who've played your sideshows don't feel cheated.
